title: Private Customized Oahu Full Day Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Are you looking to have an amazing time and create unforgettable memories?
Then, this private customized tour is for you. Experience Oahu’s majestic beaches and scenery, historical places(Haleiwa Town and Dole Plantation), Hawaiian hospitality with lei ceremony and our famous Leonard’s malasada breakfast. Have fun with nature, snorkeling in Shark’s Cove, turtle sightings while paddle boarding, or swimming under a waterfall. And for the foodie in you, taste delicious local eats and island favorites from fresh poke, famous food trucks, shave ice, tropical fruits, and much more.

* Personalized attention from our knowledgeable and friendly guide
* 100% Customizable to your group's special needs
* Escorted around Oahu's must see locations in style and comfort

Make your vacation unforgettable!
